verdict_text: NO. The merge takes the second task vector against the already-modified tensor instead of the unmodified base: `tmp = b + λ(f1 - b)` and then `tmp + λ(f2 - tmp)`, which expands to `b + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2-b) - λ²(f1-b)`, not the formula in Required result step 2. This is exactly the ordering hazard the Objective calls out ("each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base"), and the extra `-0.16·(ft1-base)` term will generally exceed the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance. The shared-tensor verification, merge count, and output count checks are otherwise implemented correctly.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
